caption: This is a bowl of tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth swirling around tender noodles and cabbage. A dollop of red chili paste sits atop, contrasting the pale broth in a white bowl with black Greek key patterns, set on a wooden table under warm light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows grain pattern, light brown color, smooth texture with subtle natural variations and slight sheen.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is light brown, creamy, and slightly cloudy with visible noodles and toppings.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
